name: MS-03
label: Likely R

key_factors: Incumbent Guest with large financial advantage
model.rationale: Guest holds a heavily Republican seat, has out-raised Chiaradio by more than five to one, and prediction markets give him roughly a 98% chance of winning. With no polls or expert ratings suggesting vulnerability, the fundamentals point to a comfortable Republican hold.
model.watch: A sudden influx of outside spending against Guest or a major scandal would be the main way this race could tighten.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: Michael Guest, the Republican incumbent, is seeking another term in a Mississippi district that leans about fourteen points Republican. His Democratic challenger, Michael Chiaradio, has raised only about $155,000 and has limited cash on hand, while Guest has built a large financial cushion. A Libertarian candidate is also on the ballot. No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so expectations rest on the district's partisan lean, incumbency, and the lopsided fundraising gap. Prediction markets price a Republican win at roughly 98 percent. The forecast is a Safe Republican hold, with Guest favored by about fifteen and a half points. The main uncertainty is the absence of polling, which leaves some room for error in either direction.
